projects.title: Arrow Flux
projects.description: A game about timing and aim. The idea is simple; getting it to feel right is the hard part, and that's exactly where we are now.

projects.title: Trail Mark
projects.description: A small app for keeping up daily habits. We started building it because none of the trackers we tried ever stuck with us.

projects.title: InkFlow
projects.description: A free browser tool that turns any font and your text into an animated write-on — export as Lottie, MP4, GIF, or WebM. Nothing leaves your device.

projects.title: And beyond
projects.description: Apps and games are chapter one. Tools, services, experiments — the list is long, and we're not in a rush to shorten it.

blogs.title: Meet InkFlow — turn any font into an animated write-on
blogs.coverCaption: InkFlow animates your text one stroke at a time — outline, fill, and true handwriting styles.
blogs.author: The Sadapanna team
blogs.excerpt: Type a word, pick a font, and watch it get written on-screen, letter by letter — then download it as a Lottie, video, or GIF and drop it into your project. Free, in-browser, and nothing you type ever leaves your device.
